about: Caption templates ported from Watchfiwn (subtitles.js STYLE_PRESETS + dynamic-captions.js). Shared by the Studio Video step (Rust preview) and python/caption_engine.py (ASS renderer). size = font size in % of the frame height; posX/posY = caption centre in % of the frame. Recap templates are MangaVox's own. Optional motion keys (sweep, bounce, trail, fadeOut, boxColors, bgMode, bubble, bgBorder, bgAccent) are documented in caption_engine.py.
